name: Groupon
notes: not_member (agent-judge-pro104): Sale consideration (decisions.md D4; config trap): Groupon Inc. bought HV's CityDeal GmbH in May 2010. The firm's own 2011 page files the position under 'Groupon' and says so: 'CityDeal GmbH was founded in 2009 ... Groupon Inc. acquired all shares in the company in May 2010'. CityDeal is the member.

name: boku
notes: not_member (agent-judge-pro104): Sale consideration (decisions.md D4): Boku bought HV's mopay in Oct 2014 ('Boku Buys Germany's Mopay In Carrier Billing Consolidation', TechCrunch 2014-10-07; the firm's own news post of the same date); HV's Boku line is dated 2014-12-31, the closing, and no financing of Boku naming HV was found. mopay is the member.

name: Care.com
notes: not_member (agent-judge-pro104): Sale consideration (decisions.md D4): HV's Care.com stock came from the sale of HV's Betreut.de to Care.com in July 2012. Care.com's Sixth Amended and Restated Investors' Rights Agreement, filed with its 2013 IPO registration, lists Holtzbrinck Ventures GmbH & Co. KG beside Rocket Internet and Betreut.de's Berlin founders and angels; no financing of Care.com naming HV was found. Betreut.de is the member.

name: Rocket Internet
notes: not_member (agent-judge-pro104): Sale consideration (decisions.md D4; config trap): the firm's own 2015 page: 'Prior to Rocket's IPO, Holtzbrinck Ventures decided to sell its entire shareholding in selected companies to Rocket and thus became a direct shareholder.' The investments are the Rocket companies (Dafiti, Lazada, lamoda, Linio, Jabong, Namshi, Easy Taxi and the rest), each its own member row.

name: SumUp
notes: not_member (agent-judge-pro104): Sale consideration by share swap (decisions.md D4; COLLECTION.md s1, Point Nine 2026-09-26): HV's company was payleven, whose first round of summer 2012 it joined with NEA and ru-Net (TechCrunch, 2012-06-22) and which merged into SumUp in April 2016 with payleven's investors 'coming in behind the merged company' (TechCrunch, 2016-04-27). HV's export files that position as SumUp with payleven's year (HV Entry 2012, Fund V, later moved to the Coco continuation fund). No SumUp financing names Holtzbrinck or HV (the 2012 Series A, the 2013-15 rounds, the 2022 EUR 590M and the 2023 EUR 285M rounds). payleven is the member.

name: Cabify
notes: not_member (agent-judge-pro104): Sale consideration (decisions.md D4): HV's Cabify line carries Easy Taxi's entry (export: HV Entry 2014, Fund V and Fund Coco; Storyblok entry 2014-09, partner Christian Saller, Easy Taxi's deal partner on the 2015 site). Cabify absorbed Easy Taxi in 2017; no financing of Cabify naming HV was found (the firm-name search returns nothing for Cabify). Easy Taxi is the member.
